method_card.mechanism: Run local AlphaFold 3 on the immutable published Top7 1QYS calibration input.
method_card.objective: Predict the observed fragment for comparison with a separately supplied reference.
method_card.estimator: Single GPU inference; seed 1, 10 recycles, 1 diffusion sample, empty MSA and templates, 128 bucket.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public AF3 parameters; Top7 predates training cutoffs. This tests deployment reproducibility only.

manifest.licence: GX wrapper; AlphaFold 3 code and weights subject to their local upstream terms. Outputs include model terms.
manifest.licence_basis: Mounted AF3 source LICENSE, parameter and output terms (included with every model result).
manifest.limitations: Only the archived byte-identified specimen is accepted. Predictions are computed coordinates.
